blogs.title: TAVI after Endocarditis: When is the Coast Clear?
blogs.description: A deep dive into the controversial management of prosthetic valve endocarditis (PVE) in the TAVI era. This post discusses the clinical tension between ESC guidelines—which favor surgery for PVE—and the reality of high-surgical-risk patients. We analyze the criteria used in this case to confirm the resolution of infection via TEE and MSCT before proceeding with a third transcatheter intervention.

blogs.title: The Shrinking Orifice: Fighting PPM in TAV-in-TAV-in-TAV
blogs.description: Every layer of a 'valve-in-valve' procedure risks reducing the effective orifice area, leading to severe Patient-Prosthesis Mismatch (PPM). This post explores the hemodynamic challenges of a triple-stented aorta and the specific procedural trick used in this case: high implantation of the third valve to prevent inward leaflet folding and minimize the 'neo-skirt' effect.

blogs.title: The Coronary Maze: Preserving Access in a Triple-Stented Aorta
blogs.description: With three overlapping valve frames, coronary ostia can become effectively 'walled off.' This post focuses on the critical role of preprocedural MSCT in mapping the landing zone and the importance of commissural alignment. We discuss how to balance valve stability with the need to maintain future coronary access for PCI in patients with multi-vessel disease.

blogs.title: The 'Russian Doll' Strategy: Lifetime Management of Structural Valve Disease
blogs.description: TAVI is no longer a 'one-and-done' procedure for many. This post discusses the concept of a 'procedural trajectory,' analyzing how the choice of the first and second valves impacts the feasibility of the third. We examine the importance of multidisciplinary Heart Team decision-making and the potential future role of valve fracture or BASILICA techniques when transcatheter options finally reach their limit.
